# Health Authorities

This folder catalogs web-based resources operated by Danish health authorities and clinical quality programs. It includes the official digital hub for the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP), which serves as the administrative backbone for national clinical database publications and quality indicators. Additionally, it covers specialized cardiology portals that provide clinical guidelines and visual overviews of risk factors for conditions like atrial fibrillation.

## Pages

- [[nbv-cardio-dk|NBV.Cardio.dk]] — A specialized cardiology web resource cited as the source for clinical overviews of risk factors associated with atrial fibrillation.
- [[www-rkkp-dk|www.rkkp.dk]] — The official website and primary digital hub for the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program, hosting annual reports, clinical quality indicators, and methodological frameworks for national databases.
